detail.longDescription: I built Night Shift game to make learning kubernetes easier. In this game, you are a Devops Engineer working to support your project. You will get different kind of incidents which you need to solve. You will also connect with your colleagues and face situation a normal engineer would. This game is an attempt to make platform engineering fun and easy to learn. The game is a simulation of real world but all the logs shown are from a real cluster. I am working on another project Snowops Labs in which you can simulate real scenarios and incidents in a local cluster or GitHub codespaces. That is a bigger project but requires time to setup. This game is just a click away to play. Just visit the url and start playing. It's totally free. You can also save your progress to change devices.
